notes: Adds account-expiration enforcement for null, future, and expired Dispatcharr/XC accounts.
Blocks expired accounts from login, catalog access, and playback with a clear expired-account message.
Stores the last known expiration securely so saved sessions can expire cleanly later.
Adds background checks for app updates and account expiration, with notifications when Android allows them.
Adds a b33r-themed amber app UI, download web UI, launcher icon, and Fire TV banner.
Keeps Android 5.0, Fire TV, Android TV, and phone compatibility.
